message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "Left lower lobe atelectasis with volume loss", "reason": "The chest radiograph demonstrates significant scoliosis and rib deformity consistent with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. There is increased opacity in the left lower lung zone with associated volume loss (elevated hemidiaphragm/mediastinal shift towards the opacity), indicative of atelectasis. This finding is a common complication in neuromuscular disease due to weak cough and impaired clearance, directly contributing to dyspnea and non-productive cough. No pneumothorax, large effusions, or frank consolidation with air-bronchograms are evident."}
